email:
Hi Birlasoft team,

I was looking at Birlasoft's public site and noticed public material around leader isg provider lens manufacturing industry services solutions and intellibridge.

That stood out because teams selling complex enterprise work often have to reshape the same technical material for different opportunities. My hypothesis is: Complex technical bids for regulated clients likely require teams to repeatedly adapt scope, capabilities, case studies and delivery language while keeping the final document reviewable.

SuperDocs is built around editing existing documents rather than generating disconnected text in a chat window. A possible workflow would be to start from an approved proposal template, adapt selected sections for a client or RFP, and keep a human reviewer in control before anything is finalized.

I'd be curious whether proposal customization is a meaningful document workflow for your team.
